purpose: Score both supplied constructs, Fluc and Fluc-PEST, with the selected A549 task in a single run so the comparison uses identical checkpoints
task_choice: predicted_TE_A549, the task selected for the A549 arm in configs/ribonn_task_selection_v1_2026-10-19.json
checkpoint_selection: Released validation R2 descending; fail on selected/boundary ties
target_scale: Released model task scale; no inverse transform or physical unit assumption

reference_transcript.provenance: Fluc ORF supplied by Ping via the user 2026-10-19, hash-verified against assay_definition_v3

scope: Characterises the two supplied constructs. Scores no designed candidate, selects nothing, freezes no floor, and leaves every scope flag false.
no_claim: Scoring the reference establishes no stability, translation or expression benefit.
A released-task TE score is not a prediction of luminescence in this assay.
Every uridine is N1-methylpseudouridine, which RiboNN does not represent.
The A549 arm only. The T-cell arm remains model-blind.
